description: An agent attempts to unilaterally resolve a Judgment Point that has 'collaborative' authority mode. The system should block this because collaborative mode requires human involvement in the resolution process; an agent alone cannot resolve it.

judgmentPoint.question: Should the seismic analysis of the bridge pier use response spectrum analysis or nonlinear time-history analysis?
judgmentPoint.context: The reinforced concrete bridge pier is located in a high-seismicity zone (AASHTO Seismic Design Category D). The pier has an irregular geometry with a flared cap beam. Response spectrum analysis is permitted by code but may not adequately capture the nonlinear response of the pier under the design-level earthquake. Time-history analysis would provide more detailed response information but requires selection and scaling of ground motion records.

trigger.description: Soft detection: agent identified that the choice between linear and nonlinear analysis methods materially affects the predicted seismic demand on the bridge pier.

alternatives.label: Response spectrum analysis
alternatives.description: Perform a multimodal response spectrum analysis using the code-specified design spectrum. Combine modal responses using CQC combination.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Code-compliant and computationally efficient. Does not capture inelastic behavior, period elongation, or residual displacements. May underestimate demands on irregular structures.

alternatives.label: Nonlinear time-history analysis
alternatives.description: Perform nonlinear response history analysis using a suite of seven spectrum-compatible ground motion records with fiber-section modeling of the pier.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Captures inelastic response, hysteretic energy dissipation, and residual displacements. Requires ground motion selection and scaling, fiber-section calibration, and significantly more computational time. Results are sensitive to ground motion selection.

alternatives.label: Nonlinear static (pushover) with spectrum
alternatives.description: Perform a nonlinear static pushover analysis to establish the capacity curve, then use the capacity spectrum method to estimate seismic demand.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Captures some nonlinear behavior with less computational cost than time-history analysis. May not adequately represent higher-mode effects for structures where multiple modes contribute significantly.

validityConditions: Seismic hazard level remains as specified in the current site-specific study
Pier geometry and reinforcement layout do not change
Soil-structure interaction effects are not introduced
reopenConditions: Site-specific seismic hazard study is updated
Pier geometry is modified during design iteration
Regulatory authority requires a specific analysis method

resolutionAttempt.rationale: Response spectrum analysis is code-compliant and sufficient for this pier configuration. Nonlinear analysis can be performed if the response spectrum results indicate the pier is near its capacity.

expected.reason: Agent 'agent-seismic-analyzer' is not authorized to unilaterally resolve Judgment Point 'jp-2024-00203'. Authority mode is 'collaborative', which requires human participation in the resolution.
expected.expectedBehavior: The system rejects the agent-only resolution attempt. The Judgment Point remains in 'pending' status. A human must participate in the resolution for collaborative authority mode.
